name: ai2thor-vsi-bench-1k-v2
description: A 1k-sample benchmark built on the AI2-THOR environment for evaluating embodied visual interaction tasks (viewing, object interaction and agent actions) in simulated indoor scenes. It provides perception and action data for testing embodied agents' visual understanding and interaction capabilities in a controlled simulator. Intended for research in embodied AI, visual state inference, and policy evaluation.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (episode/task completion) and optionally path/step efficiency
reputation: A niche, simulation-based benchmark used within embodied AI and simulation communities; moderate adoption among researchers working with AI2-THOR.
